name: Bugsink
line: Error tracker for Sentry SDKs, hosted or on your own server.

free.text: 15,000 events/month hosted, or free to self-host

errors.math: 5,000 events is under the free plan's 15,000 limit. Only 5,000 are kept at a time, and 30-day detail isn't guaranteed.
The 75K tier costs $16 a month and keeps 75,000 events, so 50,000 events fit. 30-day detail isn't guaranteed.
The 600K tier costs $50 a month and keeps 600,000 events, so 500,000 events fit. 30-day detail isn't guaranteed.
